name: Send monthly gold SIP performance insights with Google Sheets, Groq, Slack and Gmail-repaired3 (VND)

parameters.content:
## Overview
This workflow runs on a scheduled basis, fetches real-time gold prices, calculates portfolio performance, stores historical investment data, generates AI-driven insights, and delivers actionable reports through multiple communication channels.

## How to Setup 
1. Set Google Sheet with column Date, SIP Amount, Gold Price (1 gm)
2. Set recipient email address
3. Create Slack channel: #gold-sip-tracker

## Credentials needed:
- Google Sheets OAuth2
- Gmail OAuth2
- Slack Bot Token
- Groq API / Other LLM Token

## Data ingestion layer

This group is responsible for triggering the workflow, fetching latest gold price from api, and reading user sip data from google sheets.

Flow:
- monthly trigger starts execution
- http request fetches real-time gold price (inr/xau)
- google sheets node loads historical sip transactions
- error branch handles api failure and sends slack alert

## SIP Calculation & Decision engine

This group calculates the complete gold sip portfolio and determines action based on performance.

Logic:
- calculate grams acquired for each transaction using historical gold price
- aggregate total investment and total gold held
- compute current portfolio value using latest gold price
- calculate pnl (amount + percentage)
- derive average buy price

























Decision rules:
- pnl <= -10% → loss alert (accumulation opportunity)
- pnl >= 25% → profit booking suggestion
- otherwise → neutral monthly update

## AI insights & Notification layer

This group enhances portfolio data with ai-generated insights and delivers final report to users.
- AI agent analyzes portfolio and generates actionable insights
- combine ai insights with portfolio metrics
- send formatted notification via slack (and email if enabled)

Features:
- natural language investment advice
- decision-based messaging (loss / profit / neutral)
- automated monthly reporting

## Decision Routing Layer

Routes decision output (loss / profit / neutral) into specific branches and prepares structured input for the ai agent.
